whoItsFor: Developers and teams using AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, and similar) who want current, version-specific library documentation injected into prompts instead of relying on outdated model training data.
useCases: Get up-to-date API examples for a library while writing code with an AI assistant
Look up version-specific setup steps, such as a framework's latest auth or proxy pattern
Reduce hallucinated or outdated APIs in generated code

requirements.runtime: Node.js 22.13 or newer (for the ctx7 CLI)
